Ren, T. (2009). Petrochemicals from Oil, Natural Gas, Coal and Biomass: Energy Use, Economics and Innovation. PhD thesis, Utrecht University, Copernicus Institute. ISBN 978-90-393-5019-5. http://hdl.handle.net/1874/32318

Targeted pass for the UKERC verification (UKERC CH-SC4 to CH-SC27 = the 24 routes of Chapter 5). Loaded: O&M and capital costs of the petrochemicals step ($/t HVC) and of the feedstock step ($/t feedstock) from Tables 5-3/5-4 (US$ of 2000); capex DERIVED as printed annual capital charge / 0.13 (thesis capital recovery factor 13%, 90% operating rate, p.18) - UKERC used the same derivation (its capital = Ren capital/0.13 x about 0.894 GBP/USD); feedstock-per-product and cogenerated-electricity flows from yields (Tables 4-2 to 4-7, 5-1, 5-2); Chapter 3 CO2 emission factors per GJ (Table 3-6) and Table 3-7 methanol costs; descriptions and development status. NOT in main file: all energy figures - the thesis states every energy figure as PRIMARY energy, LHV, with electricity at 55% (p.14-15) and credits for cogenerated electricity - so step and cumulative energy use are in other-values; cradle-to-gate CO2 per route (Tables 5-1/5-2, route level incl. upstream and power credits, not scope 1) in other-values; production costs per route exist only as Figure 5-1/3-5 charts (not read). Not extracted: Chapter 2 (longer version of Ren et al. 2006, held as ren_2006_001), Chapter 6 (qualitative innovation study), Chapter 1 definitions beyond those cited. Locator: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 11). Chapter 3 is a longer version of Ren, Patel and Blok (2008) Energy 33(5):817-833 (stated p.47); Chapters 4 and 5 state only co-authors (Patel; Daniels, Patel, Blok) - the notes cite them as Ren and Patel 2009 and Ren et al. 2009 (the corresponding Resources, Conservation and Recycling papers), identified outside the thesis. Traps: tables 4-x and 5-x are printed landscape with merged cells - one cost cell spans Oil and Waste Naphtha SC, Coal MTO I/II/CCS + Ligno MTO (MTO step), Ligno ETE II+III, Maize+Sugar Cane ETE; the electricity-cogeneration cell of Table 5-2 spans Coal MTO CCS, Coal Direct and Coal FT I. Read from page images.

(1) OCM I electricity cogeneration is 13 GJe/t HVC in Table 5-1 but 19 in Table 4-5 and p.57. (2) Feedstock-step costs for naphtha routes are "$/t feedstock" without saying whether per t naphtha or per t naphtha-value equivalent. (3) Capital costs are printed as annualised $/t, not investment. (4) HVC definition weights non-olefins at 50%.
